_comment: Session-based split for REAL board data (data/raw/<session>/). A session is one recording session: the board is re-placed in the box and the setup recorded in session.json. Windows from one session never appear in two splits. Round 2 (2026-11-18): S04 was the round-1 held-out session, but its results informed a preprocessing change (label-consistency rule), so it is now VALIDATION / development evidence only - never trained on, never reported as the final test. S05 is a NORMAL-only training session. S06 is the new independent test session, evaluated once by tools/ml/evaluate_test.py against the frozen model (models/frozen.json); train.py never reads test sessions. Round-1 split kept in data/splits_round1_20261118.json.
